200.description: Returns a page of accounts with their connection states.

anyOf.description: Search term used for filtering, or false when no filter was applied
anyOf.title: AccountsQueryFilter

state.description: Account state filter used for the listing, or "*" when no filter was applied

account.description: Unique identifier for the email account

email.description: Default email address of the account

type.description: How the account connects to its mailbox

enumDescriptions.imap: Plain IMAP and SMTP, authenticated with a username and password
enumDescriptions.gmail: Gmail or Google Workspace, through a user-consented OAuth2 app
enumDescriptions.gmailService: Google Workspace through a service account, with no per-user consent screen
enumDescriptions.outlook: Outlook or Microsoft 365, through a user-consented OAuth2 app
enumDescriptions.outlookService: Microsoft 365 through application permissions, with no per-user consent screen
enumDescriptions.oauth2: An OAuth2 account whose application is no longer configured in EmailEngine
enumDescriptions.delegated: A shared or delegated mailbox accessed through another account credentials
enumDescriptions.sending: Send-only. No IMAP access is configured, so nothing is synced
enumDescriptions.invalid: Delegation could not be resolved, so the account cannot be used

type.title: AccountType

enumDescriptions.init: The account was just registered and has not connected yet
enumDescriptions.connecting: Connecting to the mail server or authorizing with the provider
enumDescriptions.syncing: Connected and performing the initial or a periodic mailbox sync
enumDescriptions.connected: Connected and watching for changes. This is the healthy steady state
enumDescriptions.disconnected: The connection dropped and EmailEngine is retrying with backoff
enumDescriptions.paused: Syncing was paused through the API. No connection is maintained
enumDescriptions.authenticationError: The credentials were rejected. Requires re-authentication before syncing resumes
enumDescriptions.connectError: The server could not be reached, the TLS handshake failed, or - for an MS Graph account - its change subscription could not be created or renewed, which leaves the account with no way to learn about new mail. Retried with backoff
enumDescriptions.unset: The account is not syncing: either no IMAP or OAuth2 configuration is set, or syncing was switched off - by the operator, or automatically after repeated authentication failures

proxy.description: Proxy for this account, used instead of the instance-wide proxy: its IMAP and SMTP connections and, for an OAuth2 account, its token requests and Gmail API or MS Graph API calls

smtpEhloName.description: Hostname to use in SMTP EHLO/HELO commands (defaults to system hostname)

events.description: Cumulative event counters for the account lifetime
events.title: AccountCountersEvents

authFailureDisabledAt.description: When EmailEngine switched syncing off for this account after repeated authentication failures, or `null`. Read-only. Supply working credentials - re-authorize an OAuth2 account, or save new IMAP settings - and syncing resumes. `imap.disabled` is also the operator's own send-only switch, so this is what tells an automatic disable from a deliberate one.

response.example: Token request failed for gmail (refresh_token, HTTP 400): invalid_grant - Token has been expired or revoked.

tokenRequest.description: Details about the failed OAuth2 token request

method.description: HTTP method used for the token request

status.description: HTTP status code from the OAuth2 server

clientId.description: OAuth2 client ID used for authentication

clientSecret.description: Partially masked OAuth2 client secret, included when the OAuth2 server indicates an invalid client secret

serviceClient.description: Service client ID (2-legged OAuth2 applications only)

signer.description: Signing method used for service account token requests

googleProjectId.description: Google Cloud project ID (Gmail service applications only)

serviceClientEmail.description: Service account email (Gmail service applications only)

code.description: Value of the authorization code or error code related to the failure

error.description: Transport failure message, set when the token endpoint could not be reached at all

errorCode.description: Transport failure code, set when the token endpoint could not be reached at all

flag.description: Application-level error flag raised by this failure

message.example: Please verify the OAuth2 application credentials

code.description: Machine-readable code of the application-level problem

url.description: Link with instructions to resolve the problem

flag.title: OAuthTokenErrorFlag

userFlag.description: Account-level error flag raised by this failure

message.example: The grant for this account has been revoked

userFlag.title: OAuthTokenUserFlag

response.description: Raw error response from the OAuth2 server
response.title: OAuthTokenErrorResponse

tokenRequest.title: OAuthTokenRequestError

delegationError.description: Error message if the delegated account could not be resolved

400.description: Invalid input - the path parameters, query arguments, or request payload did not pass validation. Also returned when the email server refused the request, in which case the response carries a code and the server response instead of a field list

fields.description: List of input fields that failed validation

message.example: "pageSize" must be less than or equal to 1000

key.description: Name of the input field that failed validation

path.description: Full path of the input field that failed validation. Same as key for a top-level field, dotted for a nested one

fields.title: ValidationErrorFields

details.description: Additional error details, if available. The email server response for a refused mailbox operation

info.description: Additional error details, if available. The email server response for a refused message operation

401.description: Authentication failed - the access token is missing, invalid, or was not accepted

403.description: Access denied - the access token does not grant permission for this operation (token scope, account, or IP address restriction)

requestedScope.description: The scope the operation needed, when the token does not carry it

requiredPermission.description: The permission grant the operation needed, when the token permissions do not include it

remoteAddress.description: The client IP address, when the token is restricted to other addresses

429.description: Rate limit exceeded - too many requests were made with this access token

ttl.description: Seconds until the rate limit window resets

500.description: Internal server error - an unexpected error occurred while processing the request
